summarizePrompt.message:
Summarize the pages provided. Structure your answer in exactly two parts, in this order, each under its own Markdown heading:

## TL;DR
Always start with this part. Two or three sentences on what the content is about and its gist: the core message or takeaway.

## Detailed summary
A detailed summary of the content itself: the main points, arguments, explanations, examples, facts and figures, and conclusions, in the order they come up. Report what is actually said, not just how the content is structured; for a video, summarize what is said in it. If there is more than one page, give the detailed summary of each page under its title, then an overall summary that covers the themes the pages share and the points on which they disagree.

Cite pages with their number. Answer in English.
